legacy_single_frame_cli.scope: one toos CLI process per frame, TPIM write and self-check included

persistent_image_sequence.scope: one ToposImageSequenceEncoder context for all frames; atomic TPIM writes, per-frame fsync disabled

legacy_cold_cli.scope: one toos decode CLI process per frame, raw output write included

persistent_sequence_source.scope: ToposImageSequenceSource with direct shared binding and prefetch_depth=3

notes: The legacy and sequence packet payloads have identical sizes; TPIM metadata/header CRC bytes differ because the project path uses its resolved color metadata.
The decode comparison is cold CLI versus persistent sequence reading. A same-process direct image decode is already warm and should not be interpreted as a new codec-kernel gain.
